external_entities.name: JSON-RPC Client
external_entities.description: External application or wallet querying chain ID via JSON-RPC
external_entities.trust_rationale: External client making RPC requests; could be any network participant with no authentication requirement

external_entities.name: Wallet Application
external_entities.description: User's wallet application requesting chain ID for transaction signing
external_entities.trust_rationale: User's local wallet software; authenticated by user's choice but could be compromised or malicious

external_entities.name: Requesting Application
external_entities.description: dApp or application requesting silent signing permission from user's wallet
external_entities.trust_rationale: External dApp requesting signing permissions; no prior trust relationship, requires user consent

external_entities.name: Wallet User
external_entities.description: User who controls the wallet and grants/revokes permissions
external_entities.trust_rationale: The actual user controlling the wallet; trusted for consent decisions but may make uninformed choices

external_entities.name: Decentralized Application
external_entities.description: Application using silent signing to submit transactions
external_entities.trust_rationale: dApp that has received user permission; trusted within granted scope but could misuse permissions

external_entities.name: Blockchain Network
external_entities.trust_rationale: The consensus network; trusted as the authoritative ledger

external_entities.name: Permission Requester
external_entities.trust_rationale: External application making permission requests; could be malicious, requires validation

external_entities.name: Untrusted Application
external_entities.description: External application that may be malicious or compromised
external_entities.trust_rationale: Explicitly named as untrusted; may be malicious or compromised

external_entities.name: Validator Client
external_entities.description: Ethereum validator client requesting BLS signatures for duties
external_entities.trust_rationale: Trusted infrastructure component but requires authentication; compromise would enable unauthorized signing

external_entities.name: HSM or Secrets Manager
external_entities.description: Hardware security module or secure secrets storage holding private keys
external_entities.trust_rationale: Secure hardware/software for key storage; must be trusted as the foundation of signing security

external_entities.name: Untrusted Network
external_entities.description: Network through which signing requests arrive
external_entities.trust_rationale: Explicitly named as untrusted; network layer subject to interception and manipulation

external_entities.name: HTTP Client
external_entities.description: Client making HTTP requests to the BLS remote signer
external_entities.trust_rationale: Generic HTTP client; no authentication implied in base specification

misclassified_entities.name: Request Processing
misclassified_entities.description: The request handling pipeline that may produce errors
misclassified_entities.reason: This is an internal component of the signer system, not an external entity. Request processing is the internal pipeline that handles incoming requests.

trust_boundary_edges.data_flow: Application requests silent signing with permission params
Application prepares transaction with permission secret
Application sends permission request with validation data
Untrusted application makes request with permission params
Client sends POST /sign/:identifier with key identifier and signing request
Secure key storage provides encrypted keys
HTTP request received with request data
